17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 4943-47 North Damen Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: | B3-3 Community Shopping District
Lot Area: 9,150 sq. fi.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with a new five-
story mixed-use building containing two (2) commercial/retail spaces at
grade and sixteen (16) dwelling units above. The first commercial/retail
space will contain approximately 1,114 sq. ft. of floor area and the second
commercial/retail space will contain approximately 1,250 sq. ft. of floor
area. The proposed building will measure approximately 56 fi.-3 in. in
height. The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will be
supported by sixteen (16) off-street parking spaces within an attached
garage. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment
and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE, 17-13-1101-B, and 17-
13-1101-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
increase the residential off-street parking ratio from 50% (8 parking spaces)
to 100% (16 parking spaces), reduce the rear setback for floors containing
residential units from 30 ft. to 20 ft., increase the Floor Area Ratio for at
Transit Served Location from 3.0 to 3.34, waive the loading berth
requirement, and is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for
the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 30,517.76 square feet (3.34 FAR)

Sec. 17-3-0308 Criteria for Transit-Served Locations — Supplemental Narrative Zoning Analysis

1. The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location per Sec. 17-10-0102-B
because it is located within approximately 1,056 linear feet of the Lawrence Avenue CTA
Bus Route. The proposed mixed-use building containing two (2) retail/commercial spaces
at grade and sixteen (16) residential units above will be supported by sixteen (16) off-street
parking spaces. Pursuant to Section 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to permit an
increase in the residential off-street parking ratio from 50% (8 parking spaces) to 100% (16
parking spaces).

2. The proposed building design complies with the main building door and entryway design
standards provided by Sec. 17-4-0504 because the front setback will be at the front of the
property line, the entrance widths do not exceed 12 ft., the entrance depths do not exceed
the entrance width, the entrance is not more than two-stories in height, the proposed
building elevations comply with the window transparency requirements, and the front
doors to the building are located along North Damen Avenue.

3. The Transit Friendly Development Guide defines ‘transit friendly development’ as
development which is oriented towards and integrated with adjacent transit. The proposed
mixed-use building incorporates accessibility and connectivity to mass transit based on its
location near the Lawrence CTA Bus Route. The Applicant believes the redevelopment of
an underutilized lot will improve the subject area for residents and other commuters
traveling in the subject area.

4. The proposed mixed-use building will contain approximately 2,354 sq. ft. of
retail/commercial space at grade and sixteen (16) residential units above. The proposed
building will be supported by sixteen (16) off-street parking spaces. The Applicant is
seeking administrative approval to permit the off-street parking increase for the residential
units pursuant to the TOD Ordinance.

5. The Applicant believes the proposed mixed-use building will provide appropriate density
in the subject neighborhood. More specifically, the project will replace a one-story
commercial building with a new mixed-use building, which will provide additional
residential housing thereby meeting market demand. Based on the subject property’s
proximity to a designated CTA Bus Route (Lawrence Avenue), the Applicant believes the
project provides transit options and otherwise complies with the Travel Demand Study and
Management Plan rules promulgated by the Department of Transportation by serving an
area in need.
